title: ArbitragePal
tagline: No-code tool for launch your very own arbitrage flash loan via an automated Go based tool
description: The project has a set of smart contracts that perform arbitrage operations. These contracts are used as templates, where a go server finds and replaces them. A shell script is then called to deployed the contracts given they user has provided funds. The next step would be to provide a watcher to watch the prices of exchanges to call the smart contract to execute a loan.
how_its_made: This was made using Go, Hardhat, and basic HTML. TBH I was busier with school than initial thought, so i did not get a lot done on this project. Go was used on the backed and used the gin framework to deal with requests.  Hardhat was used to test the contracts, and basic html was used because I am bad a frontend.
